description: Get the facts about one Fuse room from the live listing: monthly price for each contract length, any length offer, deposit, membership fee, what the price includes, when it is free, address, size and nearby universities, with the room's page URL. Give the room id or the page URL that search_rooms returned. Read only: it never books, holds, pays, uploads or signs; the booking link is the room's page on fusestays.com, where the student books.

contract_months.description: Contract length to quote price_eur for. Default 12.

room.description: Room id (like la-ri-01-01-04) or the room's page URL.

name: get_room_details

data_read_at.description: When this answer was built (ISO time), not when the listing was read: a city in saved_cities comes from the last good read, up to a day old.

room.description: The room, or null when no room has that id.

any_length_offer_eur.description: Riga offer: one monthly rate for any contract length, when the room has it.

availability.description: available_now: bookable to move in now. available_from: not free now, free from available_from. sold_out: not free now and the listing gives no free date.

available_from.description: First free day (yyyy-mm-dd) when not free now.

bathroom.description: Whose bathroom it is: the room's own (private) or shared with the flat. Every room type with a bathroom of its own says so in its name (Ensuite, Studio), so the others share. Null when not known.

count.description: How many bathrooms: 1 for a room's own or a shared ensuite, else the flat's shared bathrooms; null when the listing does not count them.

type.description: private: the room's or apartment's own. shared: used with others in the flat, or by the beds of a shared ensuite.

book_url_template.description: The room page with a start date and length chosen: replace {yyyy-mm-dd} and {months}.

contract_months.description: The contract length price_eur is for.

deposit_eur.description: Deposit in EUR on the 12 month price of prices.

features.description: What else the room page states the room or its flat has (WiFi, kitchen, balcony, washing machine and so on). Only what the page states: a missing feature is unknown, not absent.

furniture.description: Furniture the room page states: the bed with its size when the listing gives it, study desk, wardrobe, storage.

name.description: The room's name: its room type and its listing title (street and floor), as its page shows them.

nearby_universities.description: As the room page shows them: door to door times from the room's address when the city's timetables have them, else the listing's distance and time.

distance.description: Distance, as the listing gives it; null with a door to door time.

time.description: Door to door on a weekday morning, from the timetables, or the listing's travel time.

price_eur.description: Monthly price in EUR for contract_months, all inclusive.

prices.description: Monthly price per contract length, shortest first: the first start's, or the start prices_start names.

deposit_eur.description: Deposit in EUR for this contract length: two times the base monthly rent in Budapest, one and a half times in Riga (the base rent is the all inclusive price less the city's utilities).

monthly_eur.description: Monthly price in EUR, all inclusive.

prices_by_start.description: Start dates priced otherwise than the room's first start (prices and any_length_offer_eur when prices_start is null): each with its monthly price per contract length, with no any length offer on it. Empty for nearly every room.

prices.description: Monthly price per contract length, shortest first.

deposit_eur.description: Deposit in EUR for this contract length: two times the base monthly rent in Budapest, one and a half times in Riga (the base rent is the all inclusive price less the city's utilities).

monthly_eur.description: Monthly price in EUR, all inclusive.

prices_on_other_starts.description: Only for a room whose first start is at Gera's Riga spring 2027 set price (every set price start is then in prices_by_start): any other start, one after the spring window, is priced at these, Powerhouse's own, never prices. Null for nearly every room.

any_length_offer_eur.description: Riga offer on those starts, when the room has it there.

prices.description: Monthly price per contract length, shortest first.

deposit_eur.description: Deposit in EUR for this contract length: two times the base monthly rent in Budapest, one and a half times in Riga (the base rent is the all inclusive price less the city's utilities).

monthly_eur.description: Monthly price in EUR, all inclusive.

prices_start.description: Null when prices, price_eur, any_length_offer_eur and deposit_eur are the room's first start's. Else the contract start (yyyy-mm-dd) they are for: the start search_rooms' move_in falls in, priced otherwise than the first; the first start's prices are then not in this answer, and get_room_details gives them.

room_kind.description: Shared room (a bed in a room shared with others), Private room (a room of the student's own in a shared flat) or Whole apartment.

room_type.description: Room type as the site names it.

shared_with.description: People sharing a shared room besides the student.

url.description: The room's page on fusestays.com: the link to give the student, who books there.

saved_cities.description: Cities whose rooms, or some of their details, come from the last good read, up to a day old, because the live listing did not fully answer just now: whether a room is free, or a detail, may have changed.

terms.description: Fees, deposit and contract rules for the room's city.

items.description: Day of the month a contract can start.

deposit.description: The deposit rule in this city, when it is due and when it comes back.

fair_use.description: Utilities fair use rule, when the city has one.

membership_fee_eur.description: Paid once to hold the room.

membership_fee_note.description: When it is paid and whether it is refunded.

title: Fuse room details
